A potential mid-air collision narrowly avoided at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on Saturday, thanks to excellent work by ATC.

Air France AF028 (A350-900 F-HUVK), departing runway 24L for Papeete, began turning left.
At the same time, American Airlines AA1660 (A321-200), departing runway 25R for Dallas–Fort Worth, also turned left, putting the two aircraft on conflicting flight paths as they climbed out.

ATC immediately intervened, issuing instructions to both crews to turn away from each other. The aircraft reportedly came within just 400 feet vertically of one another.

You can hear the pressure in the Air France crew's voice as the controller gives them time to collect themselves and correctly read back the instructions before addressing the possible pilot deviation and providing a number to call.

Excellent situational awareness from the controller.

🇵🇱 Claims that the Kraków mass shooter held far-right views are being challenged by the city's own mayor. 

Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński claimed the gunman, who killed six people and wounded around 16 yesterday, held radical nationalist views.

But Kraków Mayor Łukasz Gibała rejected that explanation.

"This has NOTHING WHATSOEVER to do with any political ideologies. 

I don't know what the minister is basing this on. In my opinion, we're dealing with a madman here, and the claim that this is connected to polarization is unfounded."

The dispute comes just over a week after Prime Minister Donald Tusk's government faced accusations of attempting to take control of Poland's Constitutional Tribunal.

With Tusk already battling the right-wing opposition, the mayor's remarks call the government out for using the massacre to push its political agenda before the motive is even established.

Writer: Mhedi

🇵🇱 “Never let a good crisis go to waste.”

Poland’s government is living by that rule right now.

On Oct 30th, Tusk’s government suspended the President and Vice President of Poland’s highest court.

Critics, including the opposition and President Nawrocki, called it an unconstitutional power grab. 

The backlash was SEVERE, with mass protests, and even calls for Tusk to be removed from power over it.

Then yesterday, out of nowhere, a gunman opens fire in Kraków’s historic Main Market Square...

6 people killed. 16 wounded. 3 more bodies found at his home, his parents and his sister. 9 lives lost in total.

A national tragedy in a nation this does NOT happen in.

Within hours, Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński declared the shooter had been “fascinated by far-right ideologies.”

A label issued immediately, by a government that happens to be in a bitter political war with the right.

The Mayor of Kraków called the claim "groundless."

And of course, the international mainstream media immediately picked it up and ran with it, without bothering to dig any further. 

Maybe the ideology claim turns out to be true.

But when a government that just made an antidemocratic power grab rushes to pin a mass shooting on its political enemies before the bodies are cold, you’re allowed to ask why.

We’ll see if they ever present evidence. Until then, draw your own conclusions.

Source: Polsat, TVP, BBC, Facebook / Writer: Michael
